linepacks.name: LinePacks

columns.Switch: CSX — the FRNT- switch equipment string
columns.Equipment: Type — Node/Shelf/Card/Port (also called 'Type' in training docs)
columns.Status: Service type + state + bonding info (DSL/TEL/QDS/CBOL/CODISC + (N-N) bond pairs)

status_codes.CBOL: Connected But Only-Online (phone removed, internet stays)
status_codes.(N-N): Bonded pair reference — port X and port Y bonded together
status_codes.CODISC: CO Disconnect — port released, available for reuse
status_codes.DSL VACA DISC: Vacation disconnect — ports HELD, not released
status_codes.BAD xx: Bad port with tech initials who marked it

pic_pair_records.purpose: Build PIC-Pair records for as-built schematics in the cable book
procedure: Search for Route ID in Oasis
Right-click in gray area → select 'Facility Builder'
Facility Connection Wizard opens: (remote) CO on left, 'To Junction' at top, next available out records from To Junction
If no records in 'To' cable → select 'Create Facility' at bottom
Dialogue shows PIC count, status, wirecenter

fix_remove.WARNING: DO NOT open Facility Table directly in database — it WILL crash Access!
steps: Open stored procedure in design view
Change ROUTE_Name criteria to = N 'LLLL-NNNNNN' (e.g. NFRK-123456)
This narrows hundreds of thousands of records to just that cable

parts.FRNT-0306-0847: CSX — Switch Equipment string (created in Taqua)
parts.TFRD: Wire center cable abbreviation (4-letter CLLI code)
parts.PIC,19: Pair In Cable — position within the cable count

parts.BP,232: Binding Post number at the pedestal

card_rules.adtran: Shorter distance, Faster speeds. Good for odd/odd, even/even port pairing
card_rules.calix: Slower speeds, Farther distance. Wants DT on Odd-low, DSL on Even-high

cable_book_status.XD: Cross-connected — do NOT use for new assignments

answers_to_gaps.CBR: Call Back Reach number — customer's contact number, provided by customer or from voicemail/application. Can be out-of-area. Shows on SO ticket in the Contact Number field on Office Information tab.
answers_to_gaps.DUE_DATE: Complete By Date field on SO Office Information tab. The deadline for the ENTIRE workflow (all tasks, not just E.FACS). Includes AM/PM time window.
answers_to_gaps.agreement_search: You don't search separately — the SO screen shows Account, Customer, Agreement fields. The Agmt tab has full agreement details. Facilities tab shows the service point facilities.
answers_to_gaps.facs_update: Facilities tab on SO → Switch dropdown → Taqua → enter new Switch/Cable/Pair/Parent Equip/PED → Save. For disconnect: Service Points tab → select SP → Disconnect Service Point. Connect/Disconnect buttons on Service Points tab.
answers_to_gaps.edge_system: NOT a separate system. Uses iVUE + LinePacks + As-Built DWG (I:\Eng_GIS\GEO_Drawings\PonderosaEdge_Millerton_WorkOrderVersion.dwg). 125-prefixed agreements. EDGE orders in H:\Ponderosa Edge Project\EDGE ORDERS.
answers_to_gaps.heatmap: CNHeat is a Tarana wireless tool showing signal coverage/strength heatmaps. It is NOT a LinePacks feature. Used for Tarana wireless inquiries to estimate received power and coverage.

blocking_codes.PIC: Preferred Interexchange Carrier — toll/long distance carrier assignment
blocking_codes.NO PIC: No carrier for toll or long distance
blocking_codes.COMPLETE: Complete caller ID blocking — number shows PRIVATE on caller ID
blocking_codes.SEL: Selective Blocking — number WILL appear on caller ID
blocking_codes.INTL: Block international calls (PTC stopped offering international Jan 2019)
blocking_codes.NP: Non-published — number not listed in directory
blocking_codes.NO FEATURES: No special switch features or blocks
